lines.text: Endurance is your purse. Intelligence decides how well you spend it.

lines.speaker: sbMasterBlood
lines.text: Such vitality! You're ready for nearly everything I know.

lines.speaker: sbMasterBlood
lines.text: Your essence runs strong. On to the next lesson.

lines.speaker: sbMasterBlood
lines.text: Not yet. You'd tire after one spell. Build up your Endurance first.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: What are all these herbs for?

lines.speaker: sbMasterBlood
lines.text: Tonics, mostly. A little essence, a lot of mint. Mint makes everything better.

lines.speaker: sbMasterBlood
lines.text: If you find rare plants out there, do bring them by. I'd love a look.

lines.speaker: sbMasterBlood
lines.text: Rest after practice. Essence comes back, but it likes a nap.

lines.speaker: sbMasterBlood
lines.text: Look after yourself. Drink water. Eat something green.

lines.speaker: sbMasterWindrunner
lines.text: Oh, hi! Sorry, can't stop. I'm waiting for the wind to turn. Any minute now.

lines.speaker: sbMasterWindrunner
lines.text: Sefa Galewing. I shoot arrows and chase the wind. The wind usually wins.

lines.speaker: sbMasterWindrunner
lines.text: There's my runner! Ready? Course you are. Let's go, let's go!

lines.speaker: sbMasterWindrunner
lines.text: Hi again! I'm still here. Well, mostly. My feet keep wandering off.

lines.speaker: sbMasterWindrunner
lines.text: Feel the wind on your cheek? Aim a little left of where you think. Now let go!

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Do you teach archery?

lines.speaker: sbMasterWindrunner
lines.text: Only to people who can keep up. Can you keep up? Let's find out.

lines.speaker: sbMasterWindrunner
lines.text: Beat eight bandit archers in the Oakhaven Outskirts, then bring me two swiftferns.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: About your test...

lines.speaker: sbMasterWindrunner
lines.text: Eight bandit archers, two swiftferns. Go on! I'll be right here. Bouncing.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: The archers are beaten, and here are your swiftferns.

lines.speaker: sbMasterWindrunner
lines.text: Ha! You actually kept up! Nobody keeps up!

lines.speaker: sbMasterWindrunner
lines.text: Right, you're my pupil now. One rule: no sitting down in my lessons.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: What does a Windrunner do?

lines.speaker: sbMasterWindrunner
lines.text: Shoot, run, shoot again. If they catch you, you stood still too long.

lines.speaker: sbMasterWindrunner
lines.text: Dexterity for quick feet and a quick bow. Skill, so every arrow lands.

lines.speaker: sbMasterWindrunner
lines.text: You're as quick as the wind now. Well, nearly. Take any lesson you like!

lines.speaker: sbMasterWindrunner
lines.text: Light feet! You're ready for the next one. Go, go!

lines.speaker: sbMasterWindrunner
lines.text: Not yet. You run like you're carrying a sofa. More Dexterity, please.

lines.speaker: sbMasterWindrunner
lines.text: I live up in the old windmill by the river. Best view of the wind in town.

lines.speaker: sbMasterWindrunner
lines.text: Two hundred stairs to the top. Great practice. I've counted every one.

lines.speaker: sbMasterWindrunner
lines.text: Good! Now run home. Don't walk. Running counts as practice.

lines.speaker: sbMasterWindrunner
lines.text: See you! Watch out for low branches. I never do.

lines.speaker: sbMasterFrostwarden
lines.text: Hm. You walked past me three times. Lost, or curious?

lines.speaker: sbMasterFrostwarden
lines.text: Halvard Rimeheart. I came south from the snow. It is warm here. Too warm.

lines.speaker: sbMasterFrostwarden
lines.text: Pupil. Good. The ice is ready, and so am I.

lines.speaker: sbMasterFrostwarden
lines.text: You again. Good. I do not talk much. Stay anyway.

lines.speaker: sbMasterFrostwarden
lines.text: Breathe out slowly. See the mist? Now put it into the blade.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Is that sword made of ice?

lines.speaker: sbMasterFrostwarden
lines.text: It is. I teach it only to those who keep a cool head in a hot place.

lines.speaker: sbMasterFrostwarden
lines.text: Put out seven fire elementals in the Ashen Crags. Then bring me two sprigs of frostmint.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: About your test...

lines.speaker: sbMasterFrostwarden
lines.text: Seven fire elementals. Two sprigs of frostmint. Take your time. Not too much time.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: The fire elementals are out. Here is your frostmint.

lines.speaker: sbMasterFrostwarden
lines.text: Hm. Not even singed. Good.

lines.speaker: sbMasterFrostwarden
lines.text: You kept a cool head. That was the first lesson. I will teach you the rest.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: What is a Frostwarden?

lines.speaker: sbMasterFrostwarden
lines.text: A knight of the cold. Chill them, freeze them, then break the ice.

lines.speaker: sbMasterFrostwarden
lines.text: Strength for the blade. Intelligence for the frost. You need both.

lines.speaker: sbMasterFrostwarden
lines.text: You are as cold as the north now. Take any lesson.

lines.speaker: sbMasterFrostwarden
lines.text: Good. Steady. The next lesson is yours.

lines.speaker: sbMasterFrostwarden
lines.text: Not yet. Your frost melts too fast. More Intelligence, and more Strength.

lines.speaker: sbMasterFrostwarden
lines.text: I guarded a mountain pass in the north. Then I wanted to see a river that does not freeze.

lines.speaker: sbMasterFrostwarden
lines.text: Good. Now rest. Ice does not hurry. Neither should you.

lines.speaker: sbMasterFrostwarden
lines.text: Go well. Stay cool.

lines.speaker: sbMasterLightbringer
lines.text: Mm-hm-hmm... Oh! Sorry, dear, I was humming. Did I hum at you? I do that.

lines.speaker: sbMasterLightbringer
lines.text: Sister Auriel Dawnmere. I keep the little lamp at the end of the bridge burning.

lines.speaker: sbMasterLightbringer
lines.text: There's my bright one! Come and stand in the light a moment. You've earned it.

lines.speaker: sbMasterLightbringer
lines.text: Hello again! Still here, still humming. The lamp likes the company.

lines.speaker: sbMasterLightbringer
lines.text: Hands open, chin up. Think of the best morning you ever had. There. Feel that?

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Is that lamp magic?

lines.speaker: sbMasterLightbringer
lines.text: Everyone has a little light inside. I teach people to let it out, when they're ready.

lines.speaker: sbMasterLightbringer
lines.text: Beat seven cultists in the Ashen Crags, then bring me three sunpetals for my lamp.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: About your test...

lines.speaker: sbMasterLightbringer
lines.text: Seven cultists, three sunpetals. Beat them gently. Everyone deserves a second chance.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: The cultists are beaten. Here are your sunpetals.

lines.speaker: sbMasterLightbringer
lines.text: Oh, look at them! The lamp will glow golden for a month.

lines.speaker: sbMasterLightbringer
lines.text: And so will you, dear. I'd be glad to teach you.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: What does a Lightbringer do?

lines.speaker: sbMasterLightbringer
lines.text: We carry the dawn. Light to fight with, light to heal with, light to hide behind.

lines.speaker: sbMasterLightbringer
lines.text: Intelligence makes the light strong. Charisma makes it warm. You'll want both.

lines.speaker: sbMasterLightbringer
lines.text: You shine like a sunrise, dear. Take any lesson you like.

lines.speaker: sbMasterLightbringer
lines.text: Glowing nicely! You're ready for the next one.

lines.speaker: sbMasterLightbringer
lines.text: Not yet, dear. Your light's a bit dim. More Charisma, and you'll glow.

lines.speaker: sbMasterLightbringer
lines.text: I sang in a big temple once. But my lamp out here guides the boats home. That's better.

lines.speaker: sbMasterLightbringer
lines.text: Lovely. Now go and brighten someone's day. Sister's orders.

lines.speaker: sbMasterLightbringer
lines.text: Off you go, dear. And smile at the dark corners. They hate that.

lines.speaker: sbMasterBeastcaller
lines.text: Watch your feet. That's Bramble. She was here first.

lines.speaker: sbMasterBeastcaller
lines.text: Rowan Thistlefoot. I like animals. People, I'm still deciding.

lines.speaker: sbMasterBeastcaller
lines.text: Oh, it's you. Bramble's been waiting. So have I. A bit.

lines.speaker: sbMasterBeastcaller
lines.text: You again. Bramble likes you. I'm still thinking about it.

lines.speaker: sbMasterBeastcaller
lines.text: Crouch down. Slower. Hold out your hand and let them come to you. Good.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Can you talk to animals?

lines.speaker: sbMasterBeastcaller
lines.text: Talk? I listen. That's the trick most people never learn.

lines.speaker: sbMasterBeastcaller
lines.text: Giant spiders are webbing up the animal trails in the Whispering Woods. Clear eight.

lines.speaker: sbMasterBeastcaller
lines.text: Then bring me two moonbells for my den. Bramble sleeps better near them.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: About your test...

lines.speaker: sbMasterBeastcaller
lines.text: Eight spiders, two moonbells. The animals are waiting. So is Bramble.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: The trails are clear, and here are your moonbells.

lines.speaker: sbMasterBeastcaller
lines.text: Hm. The deer came down to the river this morning. Thought it might be you.

lines.speaker: sbMasterBeastcaller
lines.text: Fine. I'll teach you. Don't make a fuss. Bramble, stop wagging.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: What do you teach, exactly?

lines.speaker: sbMasterBeastcaller
lines.text: You call the wild, and the wild comes. Wolves, a hawk, a bear. Friends, not pets.

lines.speaker: sbMasterBeastcaller
lines.text: Charisma, so they want to come. Endurance, so you can keep up with them.

lines.speaker: sbMasterBeastcaller
lines.text: The whole pack trusts you now. Take what you like.

lines.speaker: sbMasterBeastcaller
lines.text: The wolves like you. You're ready for the next one.

lines.speaker: sbMasterBeastcaller
lines.text: Not yet. They don't trust you. More Charisma, and a lot more patience.

lines.speaker: sbMasterBeastcaller
lines.text: Found Bramble in a trap years ago. Three legs, all attitude. We've been a pair since.

lines.speaker: sbMasterBeastcaller
lines.text: I sleep in the stable hayloft. Horses snore less than people.

lines.speaker: sbMasterBeastcaller
lines.text: Good. Go on, then. And say hello to the crows. They remember.

lines.speaker: sbMasterBeastcaller
lines.text: Off you go. Bramble says bye.

lines.speaker: sbMasterElementalist
lines.text: Hi! One sec, I'm juggling. Fire, frost, spark, stone and... caught them! Hello!

lines.speaker: sbMasterElementalist
lines.text: Magistra Iris Fourwinds. I teach all four elements. Mixing them is the fun part.

lines.speaker: sbMasterElementalist
lines.text: Back again! Good, I needed someone to watch. Watch this. Ta-da!

lines.speaker: sbMasterElementalist
lines.text: Pick two orbs. Any two. Now let them bump. Gently! See? A reaction!

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: What does an Elementalist do?

lines.speaker: sbMasterElementalist
lines.text: We mix! Frost then fire, it melts. Fire then lightning, boom. Every pair does something.

lines.speaker: sbMasterElementalist
lines.text: Intelligence for every spell. Skill, because the good ones need quick hands.

lines.speaker: sbMasterElementalist
lines.text: You mix like a master now! Take any lesson. Take two!

lines.speaker: sbMasterElementalist
lines.text: Ooh, nice spark! You're ready for the next one.

lines.speaker: sbMasterElementalist
lines.text: Not yet! Your elements keep fizzling out. More Intelligence, please.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Um, your sleeve is on fire.

lines.speaker: sbMasterElementalist
lines.text: Oh! So it is. Hold on... There.

lines.speaker: sbMasterElementalist
lines.text: Fire, then frost. That was a lesson, actually. You're welcome!

lines.speaker: sbMasterElementalist
lines.text: Brilliant! Now practise outside, please. The curtains are new.

lines.speaker: sbMasterElementalist
lines.text: Bye! If you smell smoke, it's probably me. Don't worry!

lines.speaker: sbMasterSoulwarden
lines.text: Shh, it's all right, they're friendly. Oh, not you. I was talking to the wisps.

lines.speaker: sbMasterSoulwarden
lines.text: Warden Odalys Lanternlight. I help lost spirits find their way home.

lines.speaker: sbMasterSoulwarden
lines.text: Hello again. The wisps remember you. That one's waving.

lines.speaker: sbMasterSoulwarden
lines.text: Hold the lantern low and speak softly. Lost things come to a kind voice.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: What does a Soul Warden do?

lines.speaker: sbMasterSoulwarden
lines.text: When a foe is beaten, its spirit gets a bit lost. We help it, and it helps us back.

lines.speaker: sbMasterSoulwarden
lines.text: Intelligence to guide the light. Charisma, so the spirits want to stay a while.

lines.speaker: sbMasterSoulwarden
lines.text: Even the shyest spirits come to you now. Take any lesson.

lines.speaker: sbMasterSoulwarden
lines.text: The wisps trust you. You're ready for the next lesson.

lines.speaker: sbMasterSoulwarden
lines.text: Not yet. They're still shy of you. More Intelligence, and a little Charisma.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Are the little lights in your lantern alive?

lines.speaker: sbMasterSoulwarden
lines.text: Sort of! They're spirits who wandered off. This one's Fidget. He likes the warm side.

lines.speaker: sbMasterSoulwarden
lines.text: No spirit is ever bad, you know. Only lost. They go home when they're ready.

lines.speaker: sbMasterSoulwarden
lines.text: Well done. Now let them go gently. They've had a long day.

lines.speaker: sbMasterSoulwarden
lines.text: Take care. And if you see a lost little light, say hello.

lines.speaker: sbMasterIronmonk
lines.text: Sit. Breathe. No, you're breathing like you're late for something. Again.

lines.speaker: sbMasterIronmonk
lines.text: Master Oru Stillwater. I teach the open hand. Iron fists, calm heart.

lines.speaker: sbMasterIronmonk
lines.text: Ah. The pupil returns. So does the river. Every day.

lines.speaker: sbMasterIronmonk
lines.text: Feet like roots, hands like rain. Strike. Again. The hundredth one counts.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: What is an Iron Monk?

lines.speaker: sbMasterIronmonk
lines.text: No blade. Hands, feet, breath. Each blow builds the next, until the big one.

lines.speaker: sbMasterIronmonk
lines.text: Dexterity for quick hands. Endurance to stay calm while others run out of breath.

lines.speaker: sbMasterIronmonk
lines.text: The pupil becomes the teacher. Don't tell anyone. Take any lesson.

lines.speaker: sbMasterIronmonk
lines.text: Good. The cup is filling. Take the next lesson.

lines.speaker: sbMasterIronmonk
lines.text: Not yet. A tree with short roots falls in the wind. More Endurance.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Is that a bowl of noodles?

lines.speaker: sbMasterIronmonk
lines.text: It is. The broth simmered for two days. Please do not breathe on it.

lines.speaker: sbMasterIronmonk
lines.text: A good bowl teaches patience. A great bowl teaches everything else.

lines.speaker: sbMasterIronmonk
lines.text: Good. Now eat something warm. Strength comes from the bowl.

lines.speaker: sbMasterIronmonk
lines.text: Go well. Walk softly. Kick hard.

lines.speaker: sbMasterBard
lines.text: Welcome, welcome, come in from the cold! Oh dear, that rhymed. It does that.

lines.speaker: sbMasterBard
lines.text: Lark Merriweather. I play by the fire and teach the lute to anyone who'll listen.

lines.speaker: sbMasterBard
lines.text: My favourite listener! Pull up a stool. Mind the cat, she's the critic.

lines.speaker: sbMasterBard
lines.text: Strum with me. One, two, and three... Don't watch your fingers. Feel it!

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: What does a Bard do?

lines.speaker: sbMasterBard
lines.text: Songs that make your side braver, tunes that put the other side to sleep.

lines.speaker: sbMasterBard
lines.text: Charisma to win the crowd. Skill, so your fingers keep up with your heart.

lines.speaker: sbMasterBard
lines.text: You'd fill any tavern now! Take every song I've got.

lines.speaker: sbMasterBard
lines.text: Lovely tune! You're ready for the next verse.

lines.speaker: sbMasterBard
lines.text: Not yet. The crowd's still yawning. More Charisma, my friend.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Will you tell me a story?

lines.speaker: sbMasterBard
lines.text: Once, a knight crossed this very bridge with nothing but a sword and a song...

lines.speaker: sbMasterBard
lines.text: Hold on, it's better with music. La-la-la, the knight went... Where was I?

lines.speaker: sbMasterBard
lines.text: Oh, never mind. Nice song, though, wasn't it?

lines.speaker: sbMasterBard
lines.text: Bravo! Practise every day. Even when it sounds terrible. Especially then.

lines.speaker: sbMasterBard
lines.text: Farewell, and fare thee well! Oops. Rhymed again. Bye!

lines.speaker: goblinKing
lines.text: Stop. Please. I yield.

lines.speaker: goblinKing
lines.text: My people raid because they are hungry. That is the truth.

lines.speaker: goblinKing
lines.text: Let us make a deal instead. Your kind and mine.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: No deals. Your raids end here.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: The Goblin King falls, and the Hollows empty.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Sunford sleeps easier, and the Iron Order hears your name.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Stop the raids and trade with Sunford instead. Swear to it.

lines.speaker: goblinKing
lines.text: Trade. Yes. I swear it, on my crown.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Goblin traders set up in Sunford's square, selling things no smith there could make.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Give me your treasure and you can keep your crown.

lines.speaker: goblinKing
lines.text: All of it? ...Fine. Take it, and go.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: You leave with goblin gold. The raids will start again, but the Syndicate approves.

lines.speaker: warlord
lines.text: Enough. You fight well, I'll give you that.

lines.speaker: warlord
lines.text: The Syndicate pays far better than that town ever will.

lines.speaker: warlord
lines.text: Open the gate for us tonight, and a third of Oakhaven is yours.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: The gate stays shut. Take your army and go.

lines.speaker: warlord
lines.text: Then the Syndicate will hunt you on every road. Remember I offered.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: The gate holds. Oakhaven grows rich behind it, and its armourers remember your name.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: A third of the town. All right. The gate opens tonight.

lines.speaker: warlord
lines.text: Sensible. Madam Ash will be pleased to hear it.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Oakhaven burns. In the ruins, a black market opens, and an alchemist teaches in secret.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: The armourers are gone, and the Iron Order calls you a traitor.

lines.speaker: forgemaster
lines.text: The Colossus is scrap. I never thought I'd live to see it.

lines.speaker: forgemaster
lines.text: And there's the core. Still humming. It's warm, if you touch it.

lines.speaker: forgemaster
lines.text: You got here first. So... what happens to it?

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Stand back. I'm going to break it.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: The light goes out, and the golems drop where they stand.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: In thanks, the Iron Order sends its own armourers to Ironhold.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: The Circle should study it. I think I can carry it out safely.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: You know enough to move the core without waking it.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Within a season, Ironhold's forges are making aether-works no one has seen before.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: The Syndicate made the best offer.

lines.speaker: forgemaster
lines.text: Gold. For the thing that killed my miners. Take it and go.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: A fortune changes hands. The core stays lit, and the mines will never be quiet again.

lines.speaker: oracle
lines.text: I've seen this moment more times than I can count.

lines.speaker: oracle
lines.text: In half of them, you set me free. In the other half, you take what I guard.

lines.speaker: oracle
lines.text: Choose. I'd like, just once, not to know what comes next.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Hold still. I'm breaking your chains.

lines.speaker: oracle
lines.text: Oh. I didn't see that. I really didn't see that.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: The oracle rises through the water and is gone. Her pupil stays behind to teach.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: I came for the hourglass.

lines.speaker: oracle
lines.text: Yes. This is the other half.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: She doesn't resist. The Timekeeper's Hourglass is yours.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Her last pupil flees the temple, and the Circle won't forgive you.

lines.speaker: dragon
lines.text: Enough. You have teeth, little one.

lines.speaker: dragon
lines.text: The demon in the fortress chained my kin. I want to see him burn.

lines.speaker: dragon
lines.text: Kill me, or let me help you do it.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: I don't bargain with dragons.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: The mountain shakes as the dragon falls. Its hoard is yours.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: The Iron Order sings of the dragonslayer.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Then fight with me against the Arch-Demon.

lines.speaker: dragon
lines.text: Few would dare ask. Very well. We hunt together.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: When you march on the Dread Fortress, a dragon will fly above you.

lines.speaker: archDemon
lines.text: So. It ends. I didn't think it would be you.

lines.speaker: archDemon
lines.text: My throne won't stay empty. Whoever takes it commands the fortress and the rift.

lines.speaker: archDemon
lines.text: Three envoys are already waiting at my door. Choose who comes next.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: The Iron Order will hold it.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: The Order garrisons the fortress and seals what it can.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: The realm will be safe, and it will be told what to do.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: The Ashen Syndicate has earned it.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: The Syndicate moves in before dawn.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: From now on everything has a price, even the peace.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Let the Circle of Aether have it.

lines.speaker: hero

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Banners of the Iron Order fly over the Dread Fortress. The roads are safe, the laws are many, and your name is carved above the gate.

lines.speaker: hero

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: The throne lies in pieces and the fortress stands empty. For the first time in an age, the realm belongs to the people who live in it.

lines.text: You break the throne with your own hands. No one will rule from here again.

lines.speaker: heroine
lines.who: The girl hero, telling the story
lines.text: The envoys leave without a word.

lines.speaker: heroine
lines.text: I'll take it myself.

lines.speaker: heroine
lines.who: The girl hero, telling the story
lines.text: The throne is cold, and it fits.

lines.speaker: heroine
lines.who: The girl hero, telling the story
lines.text: Three factions discover they have a common enemy.

lines.speaker: heroine
lines.who: The girl hero, telling the story
lines.text: Banners of the Iron Order fly over the Dread Fortress. The roads are safe, the laws are many, and your name is carved above the gate.

lines.speaker: heroine
lines.who: The girl hero, telling the story
lines.text: The Syndicate rules from the shadows of the fortress. Nothing in the realm is forbidden any more. It is only expensive.

lines.speaker: heroine
lines.who: The girl hero, telling the story
lines.text: The Circle lights the fortress with captured void-fire. Wonders pour out of its gates, and no one asks what they cost.

lines.speaker: heroine
lines.who: The girl hero, telling the story
lines.text: The throne lies in pieces and the fortress stands empty. For the first time in an age, the realm belongs to the people who live in it.

lines.speaker: heroine
lines.who: The girl hero, telling the story
lines.text: You took the throne. Order, Syndicate and Circle march against you together. Let them come.

lines.speaker: heroine
lines.who: The girl hero, telling the story
lines.text: Goblin traders still haggle in Sunford's square.

lines.speaker: heroine
lines.who: The girl hero, telling the story
lines.text: The Hollows stand empty, and the caravans run on time.

lines.speaker: heroine
lines.who: The girl hero, telling the story
lines.text: The Goblin King is rich again, and raiding again.

lines.speaker: heroine
lines.who: The girl hero, telling the story
lines.text: Oakhaven's walls are taller now, and its markets fuller.

lines.speaker: heroine
lines.who: The girl hero, telling the story
lines.text: Weeds grow through Oakhaven's streets. The black market thrives.

lines.speaker: heroine
lines.who: The girl hero, telling the story
lines.text: The mines of Ironhold are quiet, and the dwarves dig again.

lines.speaker: heroine
lines.who: The girl hero, telling the story
lines.text: Ironhold's forges glow blue, and its guns are the best in the realm.

lines.speaker: heroine
lines.who: The girl hero, telling the story
lines.text: Somewhere, the core still hums. The golems still walk.

lines.speaker: heroine
lines.who: The girl hero, telling the story
lines.text: On calm days, fishermen see the oracle far out on the water.

lines.speaker: heroine
lines.who: The girl hero, telling the story
lines.text: The Sunken Temple is silent. No one knows what comes next any more.

lines.speaker: heroine
lines.who: The girl hero, telling the story
lines.text: A dragon nests on the fortress roof, and answers to one name only.

lines.speaker: heroine
lines.who: The girl hero, telling the story
lines.text: A dragon's skull hangs in the Order's great hall.

lines.speaker: heroine
lines.who: The girl hero, telling the story
lines.text: The Void Rift has opened beneath the fortress. But the true test of your power waits in the Colosseum: climb its waves, and win the mythic prizes only its champions hold.
